title: Fire season is no match for 23rd BEB Combat engineers
description: U.S. Army combat engineers with the 23rd Brigade Engineer Battalion, 1-2 Stryker Brigade Combat Team work with the U.S. Forestry Service to remove hazardous trees as part of wildfire prevention measures on Joint Base Lewis-McChord, Washington August 22, 2023. The exercise was a unique opportunity for Soldiers to get hands-on experience working with C-4 explosives while supporting the local community. (U.S. Army video by Sgt. Samantha Cate)
keywords: wildfires, 12B Combat Engineer, wildfire prevention, 23rd BEB, Wildfire Season 2023
